title: Ackee and Umami Bliss Biryani
description: A unique and flavorful Indian-style biryani dish featuring ackee, umami, and bliss ingredients. Serve hot and enjoy!
instructions: Heat ghee in a pan and add cumin seeds.
Once the seeds start crackling, add coriander powder and turmeric powder. Cook for 1 minute.
Add Basmati rice and cook until it's lightly toasted.
In a separate pan, heat umami paste or powder and add ackee. Cook until the ackee is tender.
Add coconut milk and mix well.
To assemble the biryani, layer cooked rice and ackee mixture alternatively.
Garnish with chopped cilantro and serve hot.
